pz-math-10-7.text: Pip has 19 acorns. Pip finds 13 more. How many acorns now?

pz-math-10-8.speaker: narrator
pz-math-10-8.text: There were 85 flowers. Fox gave away 53. How many are left?

pz-math-10-9.speaker: narrator
pz-math-10-9.text: There are 4 trays with 5 cookies in each. How many cookies in all?

pz-math-10-10.speaker: narrator
pz-math-10-10.text: There are 2 bags with 5 gumdrops in each. How many gumdrops in all?

pz-reading-7-1.speaker: narrator
pz-reading-7-1.text: Bunny planted three seeds. She watered them every day. Soon, tall sunflowers grew. What did Bunny plant?

pz-reading-7-2.speaker: narrator
pz-reading-7-2.text: Fox lost his red scarf at the lake. Owl found it in the reeds and brought it back. Where did Owl find the scarf?

pz-reading-7-3.speaker: narrator
pz-reading-7-3.text: It was raining, so Pip stayed inside. Pip read a book about the moon. Why did Pip stay inside?

pz-reading-7-4.speaker: narrator
pz-reading-7-4.text: Marina swam to the reef. She saw a crab, a starfish and a little blue fish. Which one did Marina NOT see?

pz-reading-7-5.speaker: narrator
pz-reading-7-5.text: Dragon baked a cake for Owl. He put pink frosting and seven candles on top. What color was the frosting?

pz-reading-7-6.speaker: narrator
pz-reading-7-6.text: Otto dropped his shiny pebble in the river, and it sank. Grandma Tide helped him find it. What did Otto drop?

pz-reading-7-7.speaker: narrator
pz-reading-7-7.text: The snowman had a carrot nose and a green hat. Then the sun came out, and the snowman melted. What made the snowman melt?

pz-reading-7-8.speaker: narrator
pz-reading-7-8.text: Fox and Bunny went to the meadow. Fox picked berries. Bunny picked flowers for her mom. Who were the flowers for?

pz-reading-7-9.speaker: narrator
pz-reading-7-9.text: Captain Crab looked for his hat under his bed and in his chest. At last he found it on his own head! Where was the hat?

pz-reading-7-10.speaker: narrator
pz-reading-7-10.text: Pip saw three stars. Then a cloud covered one of them. How many stars could Pip still see?

pz-reading-8-1.speaker: narrator
pz-reading-8-1.text: Owl woke up, ate breakfast, and then flew to school. What did Owl do first?

pz-reading-8-2.speaker: narrator
pz-reading-8-2.text: Bunny dug a hole, put in a seed, and then watered it. What did Bunny do last?

pz-reading-8-3.speaker: narrator
pz-reading-8-3.text: Before the party, Dragon blew up balloons. After the party, he swept the floor. When did Dragon sweep?

pz-reading-8-4.speaker: narrator
pz-reading-8-4.text: Marina found a pearl. First she showed Otto, and then she gave it to Grandma Tide. Who saw the pearl first?

pz-reading-8-5.speaker: narrator
pz-reading-8-5.text: Fox put on his boots and his raincoat, and took his umbrella. What was the weather probably like?

pz-reading-8-6.speaker: narrator
pz-reading-8-6.text: Pip yawned and rubbed her eyes. The moon was high in the sky. What will Pip probably do next?

pz-reading-8-7.speaker: narrator
pz-reading-8-7.text: The ice cream sat in the sun for too long. Now there is a sticky puddle. What happened to the ice cream?

pz-reading-8-8.speaker: narrator
pz-reading-8-8.text: First the caterpillar ate lots of leaves. Then it made a cocoon. What came out of the cocoon at the end?

pz-reading-8-9.speaker: narrator
pz-reading-8-9.text: Owl read the map, crossed the bridge, and then climbed the hill. What did Owl do just before climbing the hill?

pz-reading-8-10.speaker: narrator
pz-reading-8-10.text: Bunny had ten carrots in her basket. At lunch she shared them all with her friends. How many carrots were left in the basket?

pz-logic-7-1.speaker: narrator
pz-logic-7-1.text: I am a bird. I hoot at night. Who am I?

pz-logic-7-2.speaker: narrator
pz-logic-7-2.text: The boxes are red, blue and green. My box is not red. It is not blue. What color is my box?

pz-logic-7-3.speaker: narrator
pz-logic-7-3.text: Pip's pet is a cat, a dog or a fish. It is not a cat. It does not bark. What is Pip's pet?

pz-logic-7-4.speaker: narrator
pz-logic-7-4.text: My number is bigger than 5 and smaller than 7. What is my number?

pz-logic-7-5.speaker: narrator
pz-logic-7-5.text: Someone ate the berries. It was not Bunny. It was not Owl. Only Bunny, Owl and Fox were there. Who ate the berries?

pz-logic-7-6.speaker: narrator
pz-logic-7-6.text: It is round. It is not a ball. It is a fruit. What is it?

pz-logic-7-7.speaker: narrator
pz-logic-7-7.text: My number is between 3 and 5. What is my number?

pz-logic-7-8.speaker: narrator
pz-logic-7-8.text: Dragon has more than 2 stars but fewer than 4. How many stars does Dragon have?

pz-logic-7-9.speaker: narrator
pz-logic-7-9.text: The cakes are chocolate, lemon and strawberry. My cake is not chocolate. It is not lemon. Which cake is mine?

pz-logic-7-10.speaker: narrator
pz-logic-7-10.text: Fox lives in the house on the left, the middle or the right. It is not on the left. It is not in the middle. Where does Fox live?

pz-logic-8-1.speaker: narrator
pz-logic-8-1.text: Owl, Fox and Bunny each have one fruit: an apple, a pear or a plum. Owl has the apple. Fox does not have the plum. What does Bunny have?

pz-logic-8-2.speaker: narrator
pz-logic-8-2.text: Bunny, Fox and Pip stand in a line. Fox is first. Pip is not last. Who is last?

pz-logic-8-3.speaker: narrator
pz-logic-8-3.text: When it rains, the frogs sing. Today the frogs are not singing. Is it raining?

pz-logic-8-4.speaker: narrator
pz-logic-8-4.text: Every dragon in the cave is green. Sparky is a dragon in the cave. What color is Sparky?

pz-logic-8-5.speaker: narrator
pz-logic-8-5.text: My number is bigger than 10 and smaller than 15. It is even, and it is not 12. What is my number?

pz-logic-8-6.speaker: narrator
pz-logic-8-6.text: Marina, Otto and Crab each have a shell: pink, white or striped. Marina has the pink one. Crab does not have the white one. Which shell does Otto have?

pz-logic-8-7.speaker: narrator
pz-logic-8-7.text: Fox is taller than Bunny. Owl is taller than Fox. Pip is shorter than Bunny. Who is the tallest?

pz-logic-8-8.speaker: narrator
pz-logic-8-8.text: All the stars in the jar are gold. Pip takes one star out of the jar. What color is it?

pz-logic-8-9.speaker: narrator
pz-logic-8-9.text: Owl, Dragon and Fox sit on a bench. Dragon is in the middle. Owl is on the left. Who is on the right?

pz-logic-8-10.speaker: narrator
pz-logic-8-10.text: Bunny has 2 more carrots than Fox. Fox has 3 carrots. How many carrots does Bunny have?
